rules.name: recon-position-mapping-rba-rbc
rules.sql: SELECT business_unit, portfolio, subportfolio, trade_group, h_p, effective_from, effective_to, created_by, created_timestamp FROM opera.recon_position_classification_input WHERE upper(trim(business_unit)) = upper(trim(:bu)) ORDER BY portfolio, subportfolio, trade_group, effective_from
SELECT business_unit, count(*) AS rows_n, min(effective_from) AS min_from, max(effective_to) AS max_to FROM opera.recon_position_classification_input GROUP BY business_unit ORDER BY business_unit

SELECT portfolio, subportfolio, regexp_replace(trade_id, '^.*-', '') AS raw_suffix, regexp_replace(CASE WHEN trade_id LIKE '%-' || upper(trim(:bu)) THEN trade_id ELSE trade_id || '-' || upper(trim(:bu)) END, '^.*-', '') AS function_trade_group, count(*) AS deal_rows FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE upper(trim(business_unit)) = upper(trim(:bu)) AND is_latest_version = 1 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ORDER BY deal_rows DESC

SELECT d.portfolio, d.subportfolio, d.function_trade_group, d.deal_rows FROM ( SELECT portfolio, subportfolio, regexp_replace(CASE WHEN trade_id LIKE '%-' || upper(trim(:bu)) THEN trade_id ELSE trade_id || '-' || upper(trim(:bu)) END, '^.*-', '') AS function_trade_group, count(*) AS deal_rows FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE upper(trim(business_unit)) = upper(trim(:bu)) AND is_latest_version = 1 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ) d WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM opera.recon_position_classification_input m WHERE upper(trim(m.business_unit)) = upper(trim(:bu)) AND m.portfolio = d.portfolio AND m.subportfolio = d.subportfolio AND m.trade_group = d.function_trade_group AND :vd >= m.effective_from AND (m.effective_to IS NULL OR :vd <= m.effective_to)) ORDER BY d.deal_rows DESC

expect.reason: every deal key of the BU must have a mapping on the value date
